description: 06-15 checkpoint (stock inquiry, subfile+SQL, part06-design-v1.md's own 'no new syntax' section): compiles D0615A/F0615A (solutions/06-15/d0615s.dspf, f0615s.rpgle - the subfile half, V1 compile-check only, WORKSTN/EXFMT cannot run non-interactively) and Q0615A (solutions/06-15/q0615s.sqlrpgle - the SQL half, a plain batch report with no interactive I/O, confirmable V2 by CALLing it and comparing its printed output against the grading table: 6 rows, exactly P00002 and P00005 flagged LOWSTOCK, confirmed real hardware by F0607A per docs/probes.md's part06-0509-procs-files section). Also seeds and runs TXCHECK for lesson 06-15 (completion condition C5), mirroring 07-05-checkpoint's own SEEDTXCKM pattern - these are the SAME literal DELETE+INSERT statements the 06-15 lesson text must show the learner running themselves (same reasoning as 05-13-checkpoint-tickets.md's own TXCKM section - a verify-manifest-only seed step would be the same 'verified path != taught path' trap 05-11 already fell into once). UNLIKE 07-05-checkpoint (which only ever CALLed the TXCHECK *PGM directly), this manifest ALSO compiles tools/qcmdsrc/txcheck.cmd's *CMD wrapper (fixing a PROMPT()-too-long bug found in the process, this wrapper had never been compiled before) and invokes the ACTUAL taught form, 'TXCHECK LESSON(...) LIB(...)', via CALL PGM(QCMDEXC) - a bare command invocation in the same CL wrapper source would hit CPD0030 (the command does not exist yet at the wrapper's OWN compile time, same problem txlegacy.clp's own fix already solved the same way). This checkpoint is READ-ONLY against ZAIKOM/SHOHIM (no WRITE/UPDATE/DELETE anywhere in either half), so no TXRESET is needed at the end - but the lesson's own warm-up must confirm 06-11b's TXRESET cleanup already happened (part06-design-v1.md:338), since 06-11b's maintenance screen CAN change SHOHIM/ZAIKOM-adjacent data the grading table above assumes is at its fresh/reset values.

steps.label: CPQ0615A
steps.cmd: CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&LIB/Q0615A) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(Q0615A) OBJTYPE(*PGM) COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: VSPLPF
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/VFYSPL) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTPF FILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) RCDLEN(133) TEXT('Part 6 spooled-file text capture'))

steps.label: CAPQ0615A
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)

steps.label: CPTXCKM
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/TXCKM) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTPF FILE(&LIB/TXCKM) SRCFILE(&LIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(TXCKM))

steps.label: CPTXCHECK
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/TXCHECK) OBJTYPE(*PGM)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTCLPGM PGM(&LIB/TXCHECK) SRCFILE(&LIB/QCLSRC) SRCMBR(TXCHECK))

steps.label: CPTXCHKCMD
steps.cmd:
DLTCMD CMD(&LIB/TXCHECK)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTCMD CMD(&LIB/TXCHECK) PGM(&LIB/TXCHECK) SRCFILE(&LIB/QCMDSRC) SRCMBR(TXCHECK)

steps.label: SEEDTXCKM
steps.cmd:
RUNSQL SQL('DELETE FROM &LIB/TXCKM WHERE LESSON=''06-15''') COMMIT(*NONE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 SQL0000)
RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/TXCKM VALUES (''06-15'', 1, ''D0615A'', ''*FILE'', '' '', ''D0615A display file exists'')') COMMIT(*NONE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 SQL0000)
RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/TXCKM VALUES (''06-15'', 2, ''F0615A'', ''*PGM'', '' '', ''F0615A subfile checkpoint exists'')') COMMIT(*NONE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 SQL0000)
RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/TXCKM VALUES (''06-15'', 3, ''Q0615A'', ''*PGM'', '' '', ''Q0615A SQL checkpoint exists'')') COMMIT(*NONE)
